scope: De-duplication pass over all 393 stories: cross-story sentences of 10+ words that are verbatim or near-verbatim (normalized similarity > 0.9), repeated character quotes, and four reviewer-flagged catchphrases (Holloway efficiency theme, Akins 'plan B', Brooks surge analogies, Harborline 6 deposit checklists). Earliest occurrence kept; later ones reworded. Excludes NWS-P070-01, NWS-P093-01, NWS-P094-01, NWS-P113-01 (whole-story rewrites elsewhere).

findings.old: Holloway repeated her caution that the hub's efficiency comes with concentration risk. "When this much export capacity runs through one channel, you watch anything that could close that channel," she said. "Weather, maintenance, a grounding. It doesn't take much."
